seo.title: 35 Portfolio Project Ideas for Web3 DevRel
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for Web3 developer relations. From documentation to hackathons, build a portfolio that demonstrates DevRel expertise.

content.intro: Web3 DevRel bridges protocols and developers. These projects demonstrate your ability to educate, support, and grow developer communities.
